Through the ages

Five thousand years of Egyptian craft.

Every tool we use today has an ancestor on the Nile. Drag through the timeline and watch dawn over the valley turn into tonight. Each era opens the chamber that carries its spirit, and the two colossi turn to follow you.

About us

The creative partner you're looking for.

We are Gorgov, an advertising agency with long experience solving creative customer needs. Our team drives real transformation in business growth through innovation.

We connect you globally and in the public sphere, put new technologies to work, and offer diverse, distinctive market solutions: software development, creative graphic design, digital marketing, video and photography. Whatever you imagine, our full media services can make it.

We encourage our teams from different disciplines to work together for the benefit of our clients and the satisfaction of people.

The three pillars

Three pyramids. Three pillars.

The Gorgov mark is three pyramids side by side: pink, gold and blue. In this valley each one holds a pillar of what we do, and each pillar holds its own chambers.

Pillar of creation · the pink pyramid

Create.

Ideas people can see and feel.

Brand identities, photography and film, and immersive VR, AR and AI experiences. This is where a business gets its face and its voice.

The cartouches orbiting the pink pyramid open the same chambers.

Pillar of growth · the great pyramid

Grow.

Reach the people who matter.

Digital and below-the-line campaigns that put your brand in front of the right audience, online and on the street. Growth sits at the centre of the valley, as it sits at the centre of our name: Gorgov Digital Marketing.

The cartouches orbiting the great pyramid open the same chambers.

Pillar of building · the blue pyramid

Build.

Systems that run the kingdom.

Websites, mobile apps, ERP and learning platforms, and CCTV. The technology your business runs on every day, built, tested and supported.

The cartouches orbiting the blue pyramid open the same chambers.

Write like a pharaoh

Your name in a royal cartouche.

Pharaohs wrote their names inside a looped rope, the cartouche, to protect them for eternity. Type yours in English or Arabic, then raise it over the pyramid.

This uses the simplified sound alphabet Egyptologists teach visitors. Scribes spelled by sound, not letter by letter, so treat it as a playful approximation.
